name: Quad Cylinder
description:
Shoots fine, feels fine, does fine. 
A monument to mediocrity, but a very dependable one.

name: Shotgun
description: Weirdly high fire rate for a shotgun, single-shell reloads, and a spread wildfires wish for. At last, a weapon that matches your aim.

name: Long Ranger
description: Built for unmatched accuracy and piercing shots, every miss dishonors centuries of craftsmanship. Try not to be disappointing.

name: Minigun
description: Once it spins up, this thing spews bullets nonstop. Technically stoppable, but you're a full-time bullet-slinger, not some quitter.

name: Leveredge
description:
Crisp lever action, flawless precision, and rugged reloads. 
Once used to win sickly goldfish at the fair, now wins gunfights.

name: Knuckles
description:
Short range, big impact.
Requires no ammo, no aim, and no thoughts.

name: Lasso
description:
Whips enemies fast at a decent reach.
Some of them come back for more, and not out of spite.

name: Revolver
description:
Reliable at all times, average at everything. 
Peak choice for people who fear commitment.

name: Bow
description:
Fires bargain-bin arrows when you quick draw. 
Bend it like you mean it to drop an explosive banger.

name: Dual Revolvers
description: High fire rate, bad accuracy, yet one reload sends both revolvers soaring into explosive usefulness. A miraculous jump from meh to mayhem.

name: Boomerang
description:
Flies out, bullies enemies for a while, then swings back for another round. 
No ammo needed, perfect for an eco-friendly loadout.

name: Sheriff Star
description:
Launches at high speed and slices enemies. 
Justice has never been this low-effort.

name: Banjo
description:
Slow and weak attacks, some healing power.
Perfect for healing your allies while destroying their eardrums.

name: Ammo Pack
description:
Explodes into ammo. More players means more bullets. 
Family gatherings have never been so lucrative.

name: Bottle Crate
description:
Explodes into healing bottles.
Guaranteed to make you the most popular cowboy at the saloon.

name: Healing Area
description:
Explodes on impact and creates a healing zone that lasts for a long time. 
Smells like rotten soup, just like any proper grandma's remedy.

name: Impulse Grenade
description:
Periodically generates shockwaves that push players away. 
Allows you to reach heights your skill level never will.
